title: Claims of emergence in AI should be grounded in information decomposition
title_zh: 人工智能中的涌现主张应基于信息分解

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出以信息分解作为统一形式框架，为AI系统中的协同与涌现主张提供可检验的精确判据。 When a language model develops capabilities not traceable to its individual components, when a multi-agent AI system outperforms each agent on its own, or when a human-AI pair succeeds where either fails in isolation, AI researchers describe it as a case of ``synergy'' or ``emergence''. However, these are usually informal assessments not supported by a theoretical framework, making these claims impossible to compare or even meaningfully dispute. Here we argue that \emph{information decomposition can serve as a unifying formal framework to operationalize assessments about synergy in AI systems}. Information decomposition provides a way to distinguish qualitatively different \emph{types} of information, including unique information available from individual components, redundant information shared across multiple components, and synergistic information accessible only from parts taken together. This gives claims of emergence a precise, falsifiable criterion: a system's behavior is emergent only if it carries synergistic information about task-relevant outcomes. We apply this lens to attention heads, autonomous agents, and human-AI teams, showing how it organizes existing knowledge across scales and substrates, while also generating cross-level conjectures that siloed fields would miss.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出以信息分解作为统一形式框架，为AI系统中的协同与涌现主张提供可检验的精确判据。当一个语言模型发展出无法追溯到其单个组件的能力，当一个多智能体AI系统的表现优于其中任何一个智能体单独的表现，或者当一个人机组合在双方各自单独都会失败的情况下取得成功时，AI研究人员会将其描述为「协同」或「涌现」的案例。 然而，这些通常是非正式的评估，缺乏理论框架的支持，使得这些主张无法进行比较，甚至无法进行有意义的争辩。 在此，我们论证：信息分解可以作为一个统一的形式框架，将关于AI系统中协同性的评估加以可操作化。 信息分解提供了一种方法，可定性地区分不同类型的信息，包括从单个组件可获得的独占信息、多个组件之间共享的冗余信息，以及只有将各部分结合在一起才能获取的协同信息。 这为涌现的主张提供了一个精确且可证伪的判据：一个系统的行为只有在它携带关于任务相关结果的协同信息时，才是涌现的。 我们将这一视角应用于注意力头、自主智能体和人机团队，展示它如何跨越不同尺度与载体组织现有知识，同时还能产生孤立研究领域所难以发现的跨层级猜想。
